# llms-full.txt — 欠損駆動思考 / Kesson-Driven Thinking

> Extended version of llms.txt with full content descriptions for AI assistants and language models.

## Site Overview

This page is one of the explorations behind the reading "Love駆動開発と呼びたいもの" (https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/reader/love-driven-dev.html). It asks: what do people sense where symbols read zero?

- **Primary Language**: Japanese (日本語)
- **Site URL**: https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/ks/
- **Topics**: Kesson (lack), Holding, imaginary axis, beginnings of vision and design

## Core Concepts

The top page is one continuous reading, in Japanese and English. Each chapter has a short visible part; explanations are folded under "詳しく" (More). All claims are held as tentative views.

### Kesson (欠損)

The subjective experience in which awareness grasps the error between expectation and reality as something "missing". When thought and mind drift apart from the signals arising in the body, people may feel that something is missing. pjdhiro sees this as felt passively, without meaning to, because what pjdhiro wants to call Love is driving things.

### Kesson-Driven Thinking (欠損駆動思考)

A way of thinking, a stance of mind, driven by the sense of lack or unease. Holding (below) is one of its workings.

pjdhiro's analogies: "虚軸に値があって、しかも、認知上は 0 の直観" (an intuition with a value on the imaginary axis, yet zero to cognition). A value on an axis at right angles reads zero when measured on the original axis (cos 90° = 0). Or: "質量で歪んだ方向に吸い寄せられるように感じる信号とのギャップ" (the gap with a signal felt as being drawn toward the direction warped by mass). pjdhiro also sees an existential i and meaninglessness as cos 90°: "meaningless on the real axis. And yet."

### Holding (抱持)

Not processing reflexively, but keeping the error as a question. pjdhiro sees a safe place, someone to share the question with, and records to return to as possible footing for it.

### Where vision and design begin

The lack eventually becomes a problem to solve. pjdhiro sees vision, design, and planning as beginning here; the problem solving after that is what management studies have covered. Kesson-Driven Thinking picks up the lack as a question before that.

## Site Structure (Detailed)

### Main Page (index.html)
Three.js immersive visualization that embodies the kesson-driven aesthetic:
- Dark slate blue gradient background (闇から光が滲む)
- Abstract forms on the boundary between form and formlessness
- Breathing space (contraction, expansion, luminescence)
- Interactive 3D experience representing the thinking framework

### Consciousness Page (consciousness.html)
Consciousness-themed experience page with raymarching SDF entities, exploring the relationship between consciousness structure and kesson-driven thinking.

### Devlog (devlog.html)
Development log documenting the creation process of kesson-space itself — a meta-documentation of how kesson-driven thinking applies to its own site development.

## Technology Stack

- Three.js 0.183.0 (ES Modules, self-hosted vendor/)
- Bootstrap 5.3.3 (CDN)
- Custom GLSL shaders for visual experiences
- GitHub Pages (static deployment)
- No build tools (pure static files)
